# The Data

```{r}
#| label: preliminaries
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# load packages
library(tidyverse) 
library(knitr)
library(gtsummary)
library(ggstatsplot)
library(downlit)
library(broom)
library(here)
```

```{r}
#| label: data
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# load the data
df <- read_csv(here("Data", "data-results-kyla.csv"))

df <- df |>
  select(
    Status,
    Agreement
  )
```


## The Relationship Between Students Status and Their Perception of NVSU's No Monday Class Schedule Implementation

The Data set is gathered from 68 students with 2 variable. 

- `Status` Regular, Iregular.

- `Agreement` Agree, Disagree.

This Data aims to determine the relationship between students' status and their perceptions of NVSU's No Monday Class Schedule, particularly its effects on their academic workload, time management, study habits, personal well-being, and overall student experience.

The first 6 rows of the Agreement data set are shown in @tbl-Agreement.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-Agreement
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| tbl-cap: "The first 6 observations of the data set."

df |>
  head() |> # getting the first six rows of the data
  kable() # creating a table
```

## Descriptive Statistics

The frequency distribution of students' perceptions of the No Monday Class Schedule implementation when grouped according to their academic status is presented in the summary table. It shows how students from different year levels and academic programs perceive the new schedule. The data will identify the majority of students who agree or disagree with the implementation, particularly in terms of academic workload, time management, study habits, and personal well-being. This will provide an overview of students' opinions and experiences regarding the new scheduling policy at Nueva Vizcaya State University.


```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Summary statistics of `Status` when grouped according to `Agreement`."
#| message: false

df |> 
  tbl_summary(
    by = Agreement,
    include = Status
  )
```
